occurrences.text: And being warned of God in a dream that they should not return to Herod, they departed into their own country another way.
And if the son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon it: if not, it shall turn to you again.
But bade them farewell, saying, I must by all means keep this feast that cometh in Jerusalem: but I will return again unto you, if God will. And he sailed from Ephesus.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
